entry.author: OmbudsmanNZ
entry.summary:
If a parent or caregiver is unhappy with a decision made by a school board, they have the right to complain to the Chief Ombudsman. Many complaints received by the Ombudsman are about disciplinary issues – and focus on situations where the student has been suspended, excluded, or expelled.
 
This video features Chief Ombudsman Peter Boshier and Newlands Intermediate staff members giving an overview on how to take the right steps for good decision making. It outlines the decision-making process, who can help guide school boards, and where to find more resources.
